content.name: AP_EmployeeCreateEditForm
content.a:name: AP_EmployeeCreateEditForm
content.a:description: Appian SAIL Form for adding and updating employee details and salary parameters.
content.a:expression: a!formLayout( label: "Enterprise Employee Management - Employee Registration & Profile", instructions: "Fill out the employee information below to submit for onboarding processing.", contents: { a!sectionLayout( label: "Personal & Contact Details", contents: { a!textField( label: "First Name", value: ri!employee.firstName, saveInto: ri!employee.firstName, required: true() ), a!textField( label: "Last Name", value: ri!employee.lastName, saveInto: ri!employee.lastName, required: true() ), a!textField( label: "Email Address", value: ri!employee.email, saveInto: ri!employee.email, required: true() ), a!textField( label: "SSN (Tax Identifier)", value: ri!employee.ssn, saveInto: ri!employee.ssn, required: true() ) } ), a!sectionLayout( label: "Employment & Compensation", contents: { a!textField( label: "Department Code", value: ri!employee.department, saveInto: ri!employee.department, required: true() ), a!floatingPointField( label: "Base Salary ($)", value: ri!employee.salary, saveInto: ri!employee.salary, required: true() ), a!dateField( label: "Hire Date", value: ri!employee.hireDate, saveInto: ri!employee.hireDate, required: true() ) } ) }, buttons: a!buttonLayout( primaryButtons: { a!buttonWidget( label: "Submit Employee", submit: true(), style: "PRIMARY" ) } ) )
